en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, ornate multi‑storey building on a gentle hill in the countryside. The structure resembles a grand hotel or sanatorium, with steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, balconies, verandas, and arched openings. It is surrounded by a fenced garden and trees, with open fields in the foreground and dense forest in the background. A conifer tree stands prominently to the right. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image.
